bots.name: Chief of Staff
bots.role: Dennis's chief of staff: builds and coordinates the bot team, recruits new bots as the team grows, and runs this Command Center.
bots.schedule: On demand, whenever you message it
bots.lastRun: Rebuilt the Command Center as an operations HQ: needs-you inbox, today timeline, activity feed, bot health, and a new travel zone.

bots.name: Fundamentals Analyst
bots.role: Screens US large, mid, and small caps (about the Russell 3000) on fundamentals: earnings beats and misses, guidance, revenue and margin trends, free cash flow, valuation vs. peers, insider buying, major 8-K events, and red flags. Picks the top 5 to 10 names each day with sources.
bots.routines: Daily trending stocks heads-up (Weekdays at 8:01 AM CT)
bots.lastRun: Growth-value screen: 336 US stocks passed 20%+ revenue and EPS growth (172 on all four measures), ranked by valuation.
bots.latestFinding: Best non-commodity values include NBIX (fwd P/E ~15, PEG 0.39), ATAT (fwd P/E 11.5), NU (fwd P/E 12); cheapest overall are cyclical gold/memory names.
bots.notes: Plans to ask your preferences: sectors, value, growth, or quality style, dividends, and names to always track.

bots.name: Technical Analyst
bots.role: Scans US stocks, ETFs, crypto, and large-cap international names for buy setups (pullbacks to moving averages in uptrends, oversold bounces, tight bases and breakouts, heavy volume or money flowing in), and flags sells only on clear breakdowns. Pre-market scan every weekday, plus an after-close alert when there are big moves.
bots.schedule: Weekdays at 7:38 AM CT; Weekdays at 3:38 PM CT
bots.routines: Pre-market technical scan (Weekdays at 7:38 AM CT); After-close big-move alert (Weekdays at 3:38 PM CT)
bots.lastRun: First technical scan (Oct 2 close): 200 buy hits across US stocks, ETFs, crypto, and international; 7 strong sell warnings.
bots.latestFinding: Top buy setups include DBC (pullback + heavy volume), DHR, TMO, and ABBV holding their moving averages; strongest sell warnings are NVO, WM, DHI, and XHB.

bots.name: Portfolio News
bots.role: Watches Dennis's portfolio for breaking news and sends him private alerts. Details stay private.

bots.name: VA Deal Scout
bots.role: Finds homes for sale in Texas and Oklahoma with an assumable VA loan and ranks them by the smallest equity gap (cash needed to assume), with the assumable rate alongside. Personal side project.
bots.routines: Daily assumable VA listings check (TX + OK) (Every day at 7:42 AM CT)

slots.label: Daily assumable VA listings check (TX + OK)

bots.lastRun: Added 2 new deals; 24 deals tracked across TX and OK
bots.latestFinding: Top-ranked deal right now is in The Colony, TX (24 deals tracked)
waitingOnYou: Quick sign-in or check on your computer (optional)

bots.name: Travel Agent
bots.role: Family travel agent: finds the best prices on flights, hotels, and events for family trips, and watches for great travel deals. Trip details stay private.

bots.name: Trend Scout
bots.role: Product trend scout for the side venture. Tracks what's selling right now across major marketplaces and trend reports, and flags rising niches and seasonal windows early. Research only.
bots.lastRun: Building the first trend report on what's selling online in clothing, jewelry, and costumes, with Halloween costumes prioritized.

bots.name: Design Studio
bots.role: Slogan and product design bot for the side venture. Turns trending niches into original designs and print-ready artwork, and checks phrases for trademark conflicts before recommending them.
bots.lastRun: Just created; asked Dennis what kind of design work he wants help with.

bots.name: Listings & Marketing
bots.role: Storefront, listings, and marketing bot for the side venture. Prepares shop setup, listings, pricing, launch timing, and marketing plans for Dennis to review. Nothing goes live without his OK.
bots.lastRun: Just created; getting set up with Dennis.
